+"""Preserve writer-owned draft requests while refreshing published requests."""
+
+
+def merge_requests(previous, generated, articles):
+    retained = {
+        request['article_id']: dict(request)
+        for request in previous
+        if articles.get(request['article_id'], {}).get('status') != 'published'
+    }
+    # Published article state is authoritative; never carry a stale draft approval.
+    retained.update({request['article_id']: dict(request) for request in generated})
+    return sorted(retained.values(), key=lambda r: (
+        not bool(r.get('published_at')),
+        r.get('published_at') or r.get('requested_at') or '',
+        r['article_id'],
+    ), reverse=True)
